Java 17 or later is required for the build, and the application can run with Java 17 or newer. You first need to clone the project locally: ```bash git clone https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-petclinic.git cd spring-petclinic ``` If you are using Maven, you can start the application on the command-line as follows: ```bash ./mvnw spring-boot:run ``` With Gradle, the command is as follows: ```bash ./gradlew bootRun ``` You can then access the Petclinic at . You can, of course, run Petclinic in your favorite IDE. See below for more details. ## Building a Container There is no `Dockerfile` in this project. You can build a container image (if you have a docker daemon) using the Spring Boot build plugin: ## Running the Container Image ```bash ./mvnw spring-boot:build-image docker images | grep petclinic docker run -p 8080:8080 docker.io/library/spring-petclinic:latest ``` ## In case you find a bug/suggested improvement for Spring Petclinic Our issue tracker is available [here](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-petclinic/issues). ## Database configuration In its default configuration, Petclinic uses an in-memory database (H2) which gets populated at startup with data. The h2 console is exposed at `http://localhost:8080/h2-console`, and it is possible to inspect the content of the database using the `jdbc:h2:mem:` URL. The UUID is printed at startup to the console. A similar setup is provided for MySQL and PostgreSQL if a persistent database configuration is needed. N

## Describe the bug

Running `./mvnw test` on a fresh clone fails — Maven cannot resolve 
`spring-boot-starter-parent:4.1.0` and related test dependencies from 
Maven Central.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Clone the repository:
2. Run tests:
## Expected Behavior

Tests should compile and run successfully, producing output like:
## Actual Behavior

Build fails with the following error (abbreviated):
Full error log:
## Environment

-  Windows 10
- Java Version:Java17 - **Maven:** Maven wrapper (`./mvnw`), Apache Maven 3.9.16
- **Build Command:** `./mvnw test`
- **Branch:** main

## Root Cause Analysis

The `pom.xml` declares `spring-boot-starter-parent:4.1.0` as the parent POM 
(line 7–8), but this artifact does not appear to be available on Maven Central 
at this time. This is similar to the issue reported in #2500 where 
`spring-boot-buildpack-platform:4.0.3` was also missing.

Without the parent POM, Maven cannot resolve any of the project's transitive 
dependencies (Spring Boot starters, H2, Thymeleaf, etc.), causing the test 
build to fail before any code is compiled.

## Suggested Fix

Either:
- Downgrade the parent POM to a stable, released version of 
`spring-boot-starter-parent` (e.g., 3.4.x), or
- Publish `spring-boot-starter-parent:4.1.0` and its dependencies to Maven Central

rows.excerpt:
## Summary

This PR upgrades the application from Java 11 + Spring Boot 2.7.3 to **Java 17 + Spring Boot 3.3.6** (latest stable 3.x release). All 41 tests pass (0 failures, 0 errors, 1 skipped).

---

## Changes

### `pom.xml`

| What | Before | After | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| `spring-boot-starter-parent` | 2.7.3 | 3.3.6 | Latest stable SB3 |
| `java.version` | 11 | 17 | SB3 minimum; Java 11 is EOL |
| MySQL connector | `mysql:mysql-connector-java` | `com.mysql:mysql-connector-j` | Artifact relocated in SB3 BOM |
| Ehcache classifier | _(none)_ | `jakarta` | SB3 / EE 10 requires the Jakarta variant |
| New dep: `jakarta.xml.bind-api` | _(absent)_ | added | Needed for `@XmlElement`/`@XmlRootElement` on `Vet`/`Vets` |
| Git-commit-id plugin groupId | `pl.project13.maven` | `io.github.git-commit-id` | Plugin transferred to new groupId; old one fails with SB3 BOM |
| `build-info` additional properties | `${maven.compiler.source}` | `${java.version}` | `maven.compiler.source` is null in SB3 parent POM |
| JaCoCo | 0.8.7 | 0.8.11 | Java 17 bytecode support |
| spring-format | 0.0.31 | 0.0.42 | Java 17 Eclipse JDT formatter |
| nohttp-checkstyle | 0.0.10 | 0.0.11 | Compatibility |
| maven-checkstyle-plugin / Checkstyle | 3.1.2 / 8.45.1 | 3.3.1 / 10.12.4 | Java 17 source compatibility |
| Project version | 2.7.3 | 3.3.6 | Align with SB parent |

### `.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties`

- Maven wrapper: **3.8.2 → 3.9.6** (recommended minimum for Spring Boot 3)

Spring Boot 3 moved from the Java EE `javax.*` namespace to Jakarta EE 10 `jakarta.*`. All affected files updated:

rows.title: fix: bump log4j/tomcat/postgresql/jackson past known CVEs
rows.excerpt:
## Summary

`spring-boot-starter-parent` 4.1.0's own BOM currently resolves several transitive dependencies to versions with real, current advisories:

- `org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-api` 2.25.4 ([GHSA-qv9r-c865-cp47](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-qv9r-c865-cp47))
- `org.apache.tomcat.embed:tomcat-embed-core` 11.0.22 ([GHSA-9xv2-5v5q-p794](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-9xv2-5v5q-p794), [GHSA-gcx9-497g-6cp6](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-gcx9-497g-6cp6), [GHSA-h3x4-894j-xpx5](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-h3x4-894j-xpx5))
- `org.postgresql:postgresql` 42.7.11 ([GHSA-j92g-9f8w-j867](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-j92g-9f8w-j867))
- `tools.jackson.core:jackson-databind` 3.1.4 ([GHSA-5gvw-p9qm-jgwh](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-5gvw-p9qm-jgwh))

None of these have a literal `<version>` pin in `pom.xml`/`build.gradle` today — they're resolved entirely through the Spring Boot BOM. This PR pins each past its advisory's own fixed version using Spring Boot's documented dependency-management property-override convention, in both build files this project ships side by side (`pom.xml`'s `<properties>`, `build.gradle`'s `ext[...]` entries via `io.spring.dependency-management`), so both build systems stay consistent with each other.

## Test plan

- [x] `mvn dependency:tree` confirms all four packages resolve to their patched versions (log4j-api 2.25.5, tomcat-embed-core 11.0.25, postgresql 42.7.12, jackson-databind 3.1.5)
- [x] `gradle dependencies --configuration runtimeClasspath` confirms the same, independently, under the Gradle build
- [x] `mvn test -Dtest=PetClinicIntegrationTests` passes (Maven)
- [x] `gradle test --tests PetClinicIntegrationTests` passes (Gradle)
